description: This file is a shell script for testing git's backfill functionality with partial clones, sparse checkout, and remote interactions. It defines test setups, clones, backfills, and performs various assertions related to partial clone mechanisms.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_trace2_data
methods.description: Verifies specific trace data collected during git operations.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks that the output has an expected number of lines.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Gets or sets git configuration settings.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server for testing remote git operations.
